description: This source file is part of the BORIS behavioral observation software. It contains a function `choose_obs_subj_behav_category` that creates a GUI window for selecting subjects, behaviors, and time intervals for behavioral coding sessions. The file imports various PySide6 modules for GUI components and project-specific modules for configuration and utilities. The function facilitates complex user interactions for behavioral analysis, implying that the file is central for user input related to behavior observation workflows.
